biomarkers.name: t(8;21) RUNX1-RUNX1T1
biomarkers.clinical_use: Favourable ELN risk; MRD monitoring by RQ-PCR. High-dose cytarabine consolidation. KIT co-mutation may portend higher relapse risk

biomarkers.name: inv(16)(p13.1q22) or t(16;16) CBFB-MYH11
biomarkers.clinical_use: Favourable ELN risk; MRD monitoring by RQ-PCR. High-dose cytarabine consolidation

biomarkers.name: NPM1 mutation
biomarkers.clinical_use: As per AML_NOS entry — favourable in the absence of adverse-risk genetic features; MRD monitoring by RT-qPCR/ddPCR is clinically used

biomarkers.name: CEBPA biallelic / bZIP
biomarkers.clinical_use: Favourable; current classifications recognize in-frame bZIP CEBPA-mutated AML as favourable-risk

biomarkers.name: KMT2A (MLL) rearrangements (t(9;11) and others)
biomarkers.prevalence: ~3-5% adult AML; higher in infant leukaemia and therapy-related
biomarkers.clinical_use: Risk varies by partner gene: t(9;11)(p21.3;q23.3)/MLLT3-KMT2A is intermediate risk in ELN, whereas many other KMT2A rearrangements are adverse. Menin inhibitors (revumenib, ziftomenib) — active in KMT2Ar and NPM1-mutant AML

biomarkers.name: NUP98 rearrangements
biomarkers.prevalence: ~2-5% of paediatric AML; rare in adults

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Blast morphology varies by underlying genetic subtype — CBF AML often shows granulocytic differentiation; inv(16)/CBFB-MYH11 characteristically shows myelomonocytic differentiation with abnormal eosinophils; NPM1-mutant often shows monocytic component; KMT2Ar often shows monoblastic differentiation
variants: t(8;21)/RUNX1-RUNX1T1 (favourable, granulocytic maturation, often granulocytic sarcoma)
NPM1-mut (~25-35% of AML, cup-shaped nuclei, monocytic differentiation)
KMT2Ar (risk depends on fusion partner; often monoblastic)
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Not graded; genetic subtype defines risk group directly

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: As per AML_NOS; subtype-specific differences in immune interaction less well characterised
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Bone marrow infiltration; extramedullary disease (granulocytic sarcoma) more common in some subtypes (t(8;21))

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: HSC or committed myeloid progenitor with defining genetic event; each genetic subtype has characteristic cell of origin
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Genetic subtype-specific: CBF AML retains granulocytic maturation (t(8;21) with granulocytic differentiation; inv(16) with myelomonocytic differentiation and abnormal eosinophils); NPM1-mutant often shows monocytic component with cup-shaped nuclei; KMT2Ar shows monoblastic differentiation with lineage promiscuity
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Different genetic subtypes lock cells at different maturation states: CBF fusions (RUNX1-RUNX1T1, CBFB-MYH11) disrupt myeloid differentiation; NPM1 mislocalisation to cytoplasm is associated with monocytic differentiation and cup-shaped nuclei; KMT2A rearrangements can confer lineage plasticity
